verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents a self-hosting path through a dedicated Docker Compose deployment guide and a self-hosting start section covering auth providers and Ollama/Azure integrations. A locally running desktop app is also offered. The evidence shows only page titles, though, with no actual one-line command or proof of a quick time-to-first-chat, and the SSO/auth configuration pages suggest setup takes more than one step. Missing for 10: the concrete single install command, evidence of reaching a working chat in minutes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the install experience.
